"""Observe the original V161 owner;run fixed full review and context removal."""
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
training=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(training)
pref=read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json')
assert pref['returncode']==0 and all(ref(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in pref['sources'].items())
post=root/'postprocess-v1'
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
owner=read(root/'launch-v1.json')['owner']
plan={'root':str(root),'training_plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),
    'expected_training_owner':owner,'retained_native_collections':pref['retained_native_collections'],
    'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),ref(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json'),
        ref(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json'),ref(Path(training['previous'])/'figures-v1.json'),
        *pref['metrics'],*pref['retained_native_collections'].values()],
    'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in (post/'scripts').glob('*.py')},
    'controller':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Wait original PID/create-time until terminal;never restart. Final91 finite Adam states/four strict loads/exact1000 V160 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam. Main review3288 calls including1644 exact control replays before storage adoption. Additional fixed12-case/raw-EMA/on-off context-removal48 calls/24 off arrays. Total5412 scientific head calls;1668 new arrays external,60/156GiB reserves.4686 main scores/30 real unscored,independent NumPy64+Decimal.72 native figures/24 triplets/five retained columns,50764800 RGB channels. Both protected GFX scenes/windows/priors/JPEGs;qualitative references,not exactGT. Actual viewing required afterward.'}
assert not (root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json').exists();save(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json',plan)
(root/'postprocess-controller.claim').open('x').close()
status={'status':'waiting-for-original-training-owner','owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},'completed':{}}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
child=None;child_owner=None
try:
    while True:
        state=read(root/'status-v1.json');assert state['owner']==owner
        if state['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review':
            assert set(state['completed'])=={'parity','smoke','train'}
            if not live(owner):break
        else:
            assert state['status'] in ['running-declared-phase','waiting-for-headroom'],state
            assert live(owner),('original owner unexpectedly terminal',owner)
        time.sleep(5)
    for stage,name,extra in [('checkpoint-validation','review_harmonic_context_trial.py',['--validate-only']),
        ('review','review_harmonic_context_trial.py',[]),('context-removal','diagnose_harmonic_context_trial.py',[]),
        ('scores','score_harmonic_context_trial.py',[]),('metric-audit','audit_harmonic_context_trial.py',[]),
        ('render','render_harmonic_context_trial.py',[])]:
        guard(training);guard(plan)
        with (root/('postprocess-'+stage+'-v1.log')).open('x') as log:
            child=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(post/'scripts'/name),str(root),*extra],cwd=repo,env=env,
                stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
            child_owner={'pid':child.pid,'created':psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            status.update(status='running-'+stage,stage=stage,child_owner=child_owner)
            save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status);code=child.wait()
        status['completed'][stage]={'owner':child_owner,'returncode':code};assert code==0,(stage,code)
    status['status']='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
    save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
except BaseException as error:
    if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
        os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM);child.wait(timeout=30)
    status.update(status='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry',error=repr(error))
    save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
    raise
print(status['status'],flush=True)
